dct_description_sm: The main goal of this project is to provide ArcticNet IRIS related projects with climate scenarios that benefit from state-of-the-art post-processing methods. Improvements (relative to previous IRIS scenarios) include the use of new simulation results from regional models, coverage of marine areas, consideration of the uncertainty on reference dataset in the post-processing, and the development of scenarios for wind speed.
dct_title_s: Providing Climate Scenarios for the Canadian Arctic with Improved Post-Processing Methods
